sourceReason: Chinese 由是奇之 continues the 武帝 of s0003–s0008; this chapter otherwise renders 武帝 as Emperor Wu, not Wu Di.

before: From this Wu Di marveled at him.
after: From this Emperor Wu marveled at him.
sourceReason: The same 由是奇之 sentence; literal also uses Wu Di while neighboring units use Emperor Wu.

before: When Hui Di took the throne, Yu was made crown prince.
after: When Emperor Hui took the throne, Yu was made crown prince.
sourceReason: Chinese 惠帝即位; the chapter’s ordinary rendering is Emperor Hui, and the unit’s own literal already uses Emperor Hui.
